{% set scn_list = frappe.get_all( "Response to SCN", filters={"case_id": doc.case_id}, fields=["name", "response_to_scn"], limit_page_length=1 ) %} {% if scn_list %} {% set scn_doc = frappe.get_doc("Response to SCN", scn_list[0].name) %} {% else %} {% set scn_doc = None %} {% endif %}

With reference to the Show Cause Notice dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, we have {% if scn_doc and scn_doc.response_to_scn == "Yes" %}received your explanation{% else %}not received your explanation{% endif %} {{ doc.status_of_response }}. However, your explanation is not satisfactory and Management has decided to conduct an Internal Enquiry on the alleged charges mentioned in the Show Cause Notice served on you {{frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy') }} regarding {{ doc.case_type }} ({{ doc.issue_in_details }}).

In view of the above, {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }} has been appointed as the Enquiry Officer and will conduct an Enquiry on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} at {{ doc.place_of_enquiry }}.

You are requested to attend the enquiry as per the above and present your version, supporting with evidence if any. Further, you will be provided all opportunity to prove your case during the enquiry.

If you fail to be present during the enquiry, the Enquiry Officer will proceed further in the matter on the basis of the evidence and records available in the case.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society

Authorized Signatory

html:
Reminder: Unauthorized Absence Letter

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

Dear {{ doc.employee_name }},

You are absent from {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} without prior permission or intimation.

We have sent you a letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} asking you to join duty by {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.add_days(doc.date_of_1st_letter, 3), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, but you did not report to work.

You are therefore called upon to report on duty latest by {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.add_days(doc.date_of_reminder_letter, 3), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} or within 3 days of receipt of this letter along with an explanation for your unauthorized and continuous absence, failing which it shall be presumed that you are no longer interested in the employment and have abandoned the same.

Accordingly, the management shall initiate necessary and appropriate action including termination of your services.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society Ltd.

Authorized Signatory
name: Reminder Unauthorized absence
